customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Target clients who have made at least one paid transaction, whether a pass, a subscription, or even a coffee at the front desk. Your widest reach for studio-wide news and announcements.

active_members.title: Active clients
active_members.description: Engage clients who currently have an active pass or subscription. Your most reliable base for retention, upsells, and keeping regulars coming back.

active_trials.title: Active trials
active_trials.description: Reach clients currently on an active intro offer as part of a trial period who haven't made a second purchase yet. These are your highest-potential leads — convert them before their offer expires.

information.label: About prebuilt segments
information.title: Find key audiences instantly
information.description: Prebuilt segments are automatically created groups based on common client behaviors.
information.update: They update over time using predefined rules, so clients enter or leave the segment as their activity changes. Pre-built segments help you target key audiences quickly without needing to create filters yourself.
information.custom: For custom criteria or advanced logic, use custom segments.
